title: Localization smoothness from a radical span
statement: For commutative rings R and A with an R-algebra structure, if f^n belongs to the ideal span of elements g whose principal localizations A_g are smooth over R, then A_f is smooth over R.

proof.text: Set B = A_f and s to the image of smoothElements R A in B. Ideal.mem_map_of_mem and Ideal.map_span map the hypothesis f^n in the span to its image in Ideal.span s. IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit and IsUnit.pow show this image is a unit. Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem therefore gives Ideal.span s = top, including n = 0 and the zero ring.

For each g in smoothElements R A, let C = (A_g)_f and D = (A_f)_g. Smooth.of_isLocalization_Away gives smoothness of C over A_g; Smooth.comp gives smoothness over R. IsLocalization.Away.mul and mul' identify C and D as localizations of A at f*g. IsLocalization.algEquiv gives their canonical A-algebra equivalence, and restrictScalars R makes it an R-algebra equivalence. Smooth.of_equiv transports smoothness from C to D.
Apply Algebra.smooth_of_localization_span_universes to B and s, using the span equality from step 1 and the smooth principal localizations from step 2.

proof_origin.place: proof of Lemma 07EU, expanded by Algebra Lemmas 00T3 and 00TC; Lean realization by A3 using Mathlib localization equivalences and the existing universe-polymorphic span criterion

lean.statement: theorem smooth_localization_span_from_radical (R : Type u) (A : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (f : A) (n : ℕ) (hn : f ^ n ∈ Ideal.span (smoothElements R A)) : Smooth R (Localization.Away f)
